name: Any
description: Let the AI choose a deck type that suits the available cards and your request

name: Aggro
description: Kill the opponent quickly with cheap, efficient threats

name: Midrange
description: Play increasingly powerful threats and efficient answers

name: Control
description: Stop the opponent, gain card advantage, then win late

name: Combo
description: Assemble specific cards that create a powerful or game-winning interaction

name: Tempo
description: Deploy an early threat, then disrupt the opponent just enough to stay ahead

name: Ramp
description: Generate extra mana quickly to cast large threats ahead of schedule

name: Burn
description: Deal damage directly to the opponent, often with spells

name: Go-Wide / Tokens
description: Make lots of creatures and overwhelm the opponent

name: Voltron
description: Build one creature into a massive threat with equipment, Auras, or counters

name: Reanimator
description: Put expensive creatures into the graveyard, then bring them back cheaply

name: Sacrifice / Aristocrats
description: Sacrifice your own creatures for value and/or damage

name: Tribal / Typal
description: Build around a creature type like Elves, Goblins, Zombies, or Humans

name: Mill
description: Win by putting the opponent's library into their graveyard

name: Prison / Stax
description: Restrict what opponents can do through taxing or locking effects

name: Toolbox
description: Use tutors or flexible cards to find the right answer for each situation

name: Spellslinger
description: Focus heavily on instants and sorceries and cards that reward casting them
